title: Cosmic Turtle Garden
description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a large sea turtle with a glowing, starry shell walking through a lush flower meadow filled with pink, orange, yellow and white blossoms. Swirling ribbons of pink and purple cosmic energy rise from the turtle, containing glowing dragonflies and circular emblems, while constellations and a dreamy sky appear in the background.
prompt: A surreal fantasy painting of a large sea turtle walking through a vibrant meadow of colorful wildflowers. The turtle's shell glows with pink and white cosmic star patterns. Swirling ribbons of pink and purple energy containing glowing dragonflies and circular emblems rise from the turtle toward a dreamy sky with constellations and soft clouds. Whimsical, vibrant, detailed, magical atmosphere.
